entities.name: High Moors
entities.description: Chilly highlands where a large, grassy, cracked hill stands.

entities.name: Cracked hill
entities.description: A large grassy hill once thought a barrow, actually a vault turned into a prison to punish its failed defenders and holding secrets that could destroy an artifact.

events.summary: A vault in a cracked hill was turned into a prison as punishment for the souls who vowed to defend it and failed.
events.quote: It is a vault turned into a prison as punishment for the poor souls who vowed to defend it

events.summary: Someone must venture inside to learn secrets that could destroy an artifact that may already be in the wrong hands.
events.quote: The artifact could already be in the wrong hands.

relations.note: The hill stands in the High Moors.
relations.quote: A large, grassy hill stands in the High Moors, cracked by some ancient stress.
